svg.title: Sulfur-doped multicomponent precursor glass
svg.desc: Precursor-loaded glass after fusion and stress relief. The list is the batch precursor composition, not a stoichiometric glass formula or proof that starting salts persist chemically unchanged.
svg.text: SiO₂ / Na₂CO₃ / ZnO / Al₂O₃ / PbO₂ / B₂O₃
Listed powders do not define final glass speciation
